CORAM: - HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMBUJ NATH -----
For the Petitioner: M/s. S. K. Upadhyay, Advocate For the State : M/s. N. K. Gaunjhu, A.P.P ---
03/09.01.2025 Heard the Parties.

Petitioner has been made an accused in connection with S.T. Case No.-137/2024 arising out of Chaibasa Muffasil P.S. Case No.0204/2023 for the offence registered u/s 376(2)(n), 506 of I.P.C.
and 4 and 6 of POCSO Act, the case is presently pending before the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-1, West Singhbhum at Chaibasa.
The petitioner is said to have established physical relationship with the prosecutrix on the pretext of marriage.
Attention has been drawn towards paragraph no. 135 of the case diary in which it has been mentioned that the victim was a major aged about 19 years.

Regard being had to the facts and circumstance of the case, the petitioner named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/- (Twenty Thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Additional Sessions Judge-1, West Singhbhum at Chaibasa in connection with S.T. Case No.-137/2024 arising out of Chaibasa Muffasil P.S. Case No.0204/2023.
